cognitive_validation.rationale: Because there is no candidate difference from empirical reality, there is no imaginary science or social organization to evaluate for immanent, systematic coherence.

novum_candidates.description: A middle-aged colonel proposes to a young woman via her mother, only to discover his real affection is for the mother; the romantic mix-up is resolved when the daughter is freed to marry a young suitor.
novum_candidates.estrangement_rationale: No cognitive estrangement is produced: the story presents a familiar realist world of drawing rooms, packing trunks, and suburban courtship. Any surprise is purely emotional/interpersonal, not the estrangement of an altered empirical norm.

narrative_hegemony.rationale: The courtship/mistaken-affection premise does govern the whole narrative logic, but centrality alone does not make it a novum since it lacks novelty and cognitive estrangement.

novelty.rationale: This is a mundane domestic-romance situation set in an ordinary suburban milieu consistent with the authorial empirical norm. There is no totalizing or world-altering difference from the real world; no altered physics, technology, or social order. It is a realist comedy of manners, not a novum.
